patch.name: Sympathetic Strings Resonator
patch.firmware_notes: Firmware 2.0+ for all core modules. Firmware 5.0 recommended for UI Button extended colour range (15 colours). All modules verified against official Empress Module Index firmware 5.
critical_corrections_from_v2: No Resonator module in ZOIA — replaced with Delay Line + VCA feedback comb filters
No CV Adder module in ZOIA — replaced with CV Mixer (attenuators set to 1.0)
Pitch Detector has only 2 blocks: audio in + pitch out (NO gate) — added Env Follower + Comparator for gate generation
VCA block 3 is 'level control' not 'gain_cv' — corrected all references
Chorus CPU is 6-10% not 3% — removed, stereo handled by Audio Balance
All grid block counts corrected to match official module block sizes
Onset Detector (12.3%) replaced with Env Follower (2.5%) + Comparator (0.04%) for gate — saves 9.76% CPU

VCA.note: min 3 blocks: audio in 1 | level control | audio out 1

SV Filter.note: blocks: audio in | frequency | resonance | lowpass output

Delay Line.note: blocks: audio in | delay time | audio out. max_time option = 100ms

Pitch Detector.note: ONLY 2 blocks: audio in | pitch out. NO gate output.

Env Follower.note: blocks: audio in | CV output. Used to generate gate signal.

Comparator.note: blocks: CV positive input | CV negative input | CV output

Sample and Hold.note: blocks: CV input | trigger | CV output

ADSR.note: min 6 blocks: cv input | attack | decay | sustain | release | cv output

CV Mixer.note: blocks: cv in 1 | cv in 2 | atten 1 | atten 2 | cv output. Set attens to 1.0 to sum.

Tone Control.note: min 9 blocks: aud in L | low shelf | mid gain 1 | mid freq 1 | high shelf | output L (optional R channel adds blocks)

Reverb Lite.note: blocks: input L | decay time | mix | output L | output R*

Audio Balance.note: stereo mode blocks: audio in1 L | in1 R | in2 L | in2 R | mix | audio outL | audio outR

CV Rectify.note: used to keep pitch CV in 0-1 range for delay time control

PITCH.description: Transpose all resonators from tracked pitch. Routes via CV Mixer pitch offset.

FEEDBACK.description: Resonator string decay / feedback amount. Higher = longer sustain. Routes to V1/V2/V3 feedback VCAs level control.

SPREAD.description: Haas delay spread for stereo width. Routes to Delay Line SPREAD L/R delay time blocks.

DAMPENING.description: Felt dampening sim. Routes to SV Filter DAMPENING frequency block.

SENSITIVITY.description: Gate trigger sensitivity. Routes to Comparator CV negative input (threshold).

PIANO_SIZE.description: Piano body character. Routes to Tone Control low shelf and mid freq blocks.

REVERB_LVL.description: Reverb send level. Routes to VCA REVERB SEND level control block.

WET_VOL.description: Wet signal blend. Routes to VCA WET VCA level control block.

DRY_VOL.description: Dry guitar level. Routes to VCA DRY VCA level control block.

note_on_overtones_knob: DECAY knob replaced with FEEDBACK knob — controls VCA feedback level on all 3 comb filter voices simultaneously. OVERTONES replaced by voice-level constants baked into connection strengths: V1=100%, V2=80%, V3=55%.

BYPASS.description: Kill wet signal, pass dry unaffected. Routes to VCA WET VCA level control override.

PITCH_HOLD.description: Freeze pitch tracker on last detected note. Routes to Sample and Hold trigger.

DECAY_KILL.description: Instantly silence resonators. Routes to all feedback VCAs level control (→ 0).

comb_filter_tuning.note: Delay Line comb filter: delay_time = 1/frequency. CV from Pitch Detector is V/Oct note value (0=A4=440Hz). Delay time CV is linear (0-1 = 0-100ms). ZOIA cannot natively convert V/Oct to linear delay time. We use Pitch Detector CV to modulate base delay times, giving approximate tracking. This is musically useful — analog sympathetic strings work similarly.
comb_filter_tuning.V2_offset_octave: +12st approximated as half base delay time
comb_filter_tuning.feedback_target: 0.75 (75% feedback = ~6 echoes = ~2-3s natural decay at 2ms delay)

gate_generation.method: Env Follower + Comparator (saves 9.76% CPU vs Onset Detector)
gate_generation.note: Env Follower tracks amplitude, Comparator fires gate CV when signal exceeds threshold

reverb.note: 100% wet — dry handled by Dry VCA. Reverb Lite is the CPU-friendly option per Empress documentation.
